page_title: NAN 1-0 AUX | Nantes v Auxerre 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Stephanie Frappart has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' After Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) gets to the ball from a cross he decides a shoot. His attempt, however, goes well wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Elisha Owusu departs the field of play to be replaced by Rudy Matondo (Auxerre).
88' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre).
87' It will be a substitution. Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) is ready to enter the pitch as Yassine Benhattab walks off.
87' Luis Castro decides to make a substitution. Mostafa Mohamed will be replaced by Amady Camara (Nantes).
85' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
85' Auxerre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Good work from Auxerre as they win a corner.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gideon Mensah leaves the pitch and Theo Bair (Auxerre) comes on.
82' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Danny Namaso (Auxerre) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Auxerre.
76' Flag goes up against Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
73' Here's the change. Ibrahim Osman leaves the pitch and Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) comes on as a substitute.
72' Substitution. Francisco Sierralta did his best and is replaced by Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre).
72' Substitution. Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) replaces Josue Casimir.
72' Luis Castro has decided to substitute Francis Coquelin and he is replaced by Hyeok-Kyu Kwon (Nantes).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bahereba Guirassy trots off the pitch and is replaced by Matthis Abline (Nantes).
71' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping.
69' Francisco Sierralta (Auxerre) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner way wide of the left post.
69' The referee signals a corner kick to Auxerre.

68' What a wasted opportunity by Josue Casimir (Auxerre)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the top of the net, but Anthony Lopes makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
65' Substitution. Louis Leroux (Nantes) on for Hyun-Seok Hong.
63' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
58' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Anthony Lopes.
54' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
51' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Stephanie Frappart ignores the protests.
49' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) pounces on a loose pass, cuts inside an opponent and unleashes a piledriver towards goal. The keeper scrambles to save the effort, but it rises just over the bar.
47' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' A snap shot by Hyun-Seok Hong (Nantes) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Theo De Percin produces a good save to thwart him.
43' The whistle blows and Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is booked for an infringement.
43' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Stephanie Frappart pulls out a yellow card.
40' Auxerre are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
34' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Josue Casimir (Auxerre), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

33' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Auxerre.
31' Yassine Benhattab (Nantes) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Anthony Lopes has no trouble gathering it.
30' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
30' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
30' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Auxerre win a corner kick.
28' Francis Coquelin (Nantes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
26' Francis Coquelin (Nantes) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
23' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is caught offside!
20' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) takes the corner but it's cleared.

20' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
18' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
16' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the left post.
14' Auxerre work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
11' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Stephanie Frappart to decide. The relieved Nantes players can finally celebrate.
9' Wait! Referee Stephanie Frappart has indicated he is going to review the Nantes goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
8' 1 - 0 GOAL! Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Theo De Percin, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:0.
7' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

6' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball would have probably ended inside the right post, if Anthony Lopes hadn't made a superb save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Auxerre will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Nantes will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Stephanie Frappart.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
